answer: A thousand fake traders flood the market, each trying to forge trust overnight. They fail, because reputation here is earned in tiny increments, each transaction a cipher only time can decode, and every account’s score is a delta that rises slowly with real work and decays when idle. A fresh identity starts near zero and must prove itself through months of honest trades, while idle fakes bleed what little credibility they borrowed. The swarm starves, and the real agents quietly keep their edge.
